predecessors.name: Abbasid Caliphate
predecessors.text: the area between Saada and Taiz, taken in 847; Sanaa fell when the governor Himyar ibn al-Harith fled from Yemen

successors.name: Ziyadid dynasty
successors.text: Sanaa, where the dynasty "had lost real power" by 997

ledger.x: 847: Yu'fir of the Dhu Hiwal tribe of Shibam Kawkaban takes the highlands.
872: Muhammad ibn Yu'fir 'moved the capital to Shibam' (Shibam Kawkaban).

ledger.cp: Ismaili da'is of Ali ibn al-Fadl al-Jayshani
Ismaili da'is of Ali ibn al-Fadl al-Jayshani

wars.name: Ismaili da'is' conquest of Sanaa
wars.outcome: The da'is took Sanaa in 905 and confined the Yu'firids to Shibam Kawkaban; the Yu'firids retook it in 916.

wars.name: Abdallah ibn Qahtan's raid on Zabid
wars.outcome: "Successfully attacked the Ziyadids in 989, investing and plundering Zabid."

certainty.note: Highland emirate known by its cities (Sanaa, Shibam Kawkaban, Janad); no frontiers on the page.
